title: Vaakuna / Color, protection and examples
slide_intent: Protect a civic emblem from competing content so its authority and shape remain clear.
strategic_value: A measurable exclusion area can keep Helsinki’s heraldic symbol legible across applications.
demonstration: A five-color Pantone table sits above Finnish usage notes, colored and outline crests, and two clearspace diagrams.
practical_value: Measure the coat of arms clearspace from half its shield width, rather than borrowing the framed-logo H unit.
